newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wrightson 1st qtr results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Wrightson 1st qtr results below expectations.

text.p: Wrightson Ltd said on Thursday results for the first three months had been below expectations, particularly in its retail and real estate businesses.
However, the company said it believed the current year's profit would be within the indicated range of NZ$24-27 million, albeit at the lower end of that range.
Chairman Sir Ronald Trotter told the company's annual meeting Wrightson was re-engineering itself to reduce costs while maintaining service and improving services.
A change from branch to divisional structure has better positioned the company to service a wider range of customers and to explore opportunities to add further value along the food and fibre chain.
